concerns.text: 'they must explicitly identify a specific subset of early-cycle features (e.g., voltage relaxation rate in cycles 10-20) as the strongest predictors' — this asserts a research OUTCOME, not a verifiable system behavior. The system cannot guarantee which features turn out strongest. Revise to a checkable deliverable: e.g., 'produce a ranked table of features with quantitative contribution scores covering all cycles/channels.'

'consistency of feature importance rankings across permutation importance and SHAP' is not measurable — no metric (e.g., rank correlation coefficient such as Spearman ρ between the two rankings) or threshold/procedure is named. State the comparison metric so met/not-met is decidable.

'exactly 50 aligned time-steps per cycle' and 'T_steps' — the uniform resampling target (T_steps value or how it is fixed) is unspecified, so the shape assertion (N, 50, T, 3) cannot be deterministically checked. Name the resampling rule or state T_steps is fixed and recorded at implementation.
